source_caption_text:
Ty Dolla $ign Brings Out Mike Sherm During His Set While On Tour With Bryson Tiller In Concord, CA Tonight 📈💯

Mike Sherm Is A 30-Year-Old Rapper & Songwriter From Antioch, California, Who Has Become One Of The Most Recognizable Names In The Bay Area Hip-Hop Scene. Known For His Catchy Flows, Clever Wordplay & Signature West Coast Sound, Mike Sherm Built A Loyal Fanbase Through YouTube, SoundCloud & Independent Music Releases.

He First Gained Major Attention With Songs Like “Ahole,” “Baby,” “Ballin,” “Hotboy” & “Side N*a Anthem.” Over The Years, He Has Collaborated With Several West Coast Artists, Including OhGeesy, Fenix Flexin & Shoreline Mafia. In 2026, He Teamed Up With Fenix Flexin For Their Joint Project Bang Broz, Continuing To Build His Reputation As A Major Figure In California’s Rap Scene. 

Ty Dolla $ign Is A 44-Year-Old Singer, Rapper, Songwriter & Producer From Los Angeles, California. Born Tyrone William Griffin Jr., He Is Widely Recognized For His Smooth Vocals, Melodic Hooks & Ability To Blend R&B With Hip-Hop. He Has Become One Of The Most Respected Voices In Modern R&B, Working With Some Of The Biggest Artists In The Music Industry.

Ty Dolla $ign Rose To Mainstream Fame With Songs Like “Paranoid,” “Or Nah” & “Blasé.” Throughout His Career, He Has Collaborated With Artists Including Kanye West, Chris Brown, Post Malone, Wiz Khalifa & Nicki Minaj. He Also Teamed Up With Kanye West To Form The Duo ¥$, Releasing Their Collaborative Vultures Projects. His Unique Sound & Songwriting Abilities Have Made Him A Major Influence On Modern R&B & Hip-Hop. 

Bryson Tiller Is A 33-Year-Old Singer, Rapper & Songwriter From Louisville, Kentucky. Known For His Emotional Lyrics, Smooth Melodies & Signature Blend Of R&B And Hip-Hop, Bryson Tiller Became One Of The Most Influential Artists In The Modern R&B Scene After Breaking Into The Mainstream In 2015.
